sql-set.sql: SELECT [Id], [Code], [SKU], [Name], [DisplayName], [ShortName], [Description], [ProductType], [BaseCost], [BasePrice], [Currency], [ProductOwnerId], [ProductOwner], [ProductCode], [ProductActive], [SalesStartDate], [SalesEndDate], [SupportStartDate], [SupportEndDate], [VendorId], [VendorName], [ProductCategoryId], [ProductCategory], [ManufacturerId], [Manufacturer], [UnitPrice], [CommissionRate], [TaxId], [Tax], [UsageUnitId], [UsageUnit], [QuantityInStock], [HandlerId], [Handler], [QuantityOrdered], [ReorderLevel], [QuantityInDemand], [CreatedBy], [CreatedDateTime], [UpdatedBy], [UpdatedDateTime], [CustomFields] AS [CustomFieldJson] FROM [AcmeProduct] WHERE [Id] = @Id AND [IsDeleted] = 0 ORDER BY [UpdatedDateTime] DESC;

SELECT [Id], [Code], [SKU], [Name], [DisplayName], [ShortName], [Description], [ProductType], [BaseCost], [BasePrice], [Currency], [ProductOwnerId], [ProductOwner], [ProductCode], [ProductActive], [SalesStartDate], [SalesEndDate], [SupportStartDate], [SupportEndDate], [VendorId], [VendorName], [ProductCategoryId], [ProductCategory], [ManufacturerId], [Manufacturer], [UnitPrice], [CommissionRate], [TaxId], [Tax], [UsageUnitId], [UsageUnit], [QuantityInStock], [HandlerId], [Handler], [QuantityOrdered], [ReorderLevel], [QuantityInDemand], [CreatedBy], [CreatedDateTime], [UpdatedBy], [UpdatedDateTime], [CustomFields] AS [CustomFieldJson] FROM [AcmeProduct] WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 ORDER BY [UpdatedDateTime] DESC;
